Start date: 1207-09-03 (YYYY-MM-DD format).  
Subtract 20 weeks = 140 days.  
Add 5 days → total subtract 145 days.  

1207 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400, so not leap in Gregorian proleptic).  
September 3 minus 145 days:  
Go back 3 days → August 31.  
Remaining 142 days earlier:  
August has 31 days, July 31, June 30, May 31, April 30 → subtract these months.  

Days subtracted:  
Aug: 3 (to Aug 31) + 31 (July) + 30 (June) + 31 (May) + 30 (April) = 125 days.  
Remaining 145 - 125 = 20 days earlier from end of March.  
March has 31 days, so March 31 minus 20 days = March 11.  
Year remains 1207.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1207-03-11
